description: This file provides utilities for formatting and obtaining RFC1123 date strings, including functions to get current UTC time in RFC1123 format and convert Unix time to RFC1123 string.

methods.name: RFC1123_GetCurTime
methods.description: Gets the current UTC time in RFC1123 string format.

methods.name: RFC1123_FromUnixTime
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to an RFC1123 formatted string.
